observedFailure: Studio test fixtures under the executor default /tmp were rejected with STORAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED
confirmedCause: Executor /tmp is sticky1777 but owned by UID65534. Existing storage validation only trusts root-owned sticky directories or safe owner ancestors.
safeFix: The CPU test runner creates its own0700temporary root under the owned repository and passes TMPDIR to its child tests; cleans up only that created root. Removed only the test fixtures hardcoded /tmp override so they use the owned TMPDIR; production permission checks remain identical.
retestScope: Only the two affected suites; unchanged previous passing test results retained by test source hash.
additionalConfirmedCause: The two newly added Studio test fixture constructors explicitly pinned dir=/tmp, so the runner TMPDIR fix alone could not affect them.
